summary.text: A 52-year-old woman with long-standing schizophrenia, described as treatment-resistant with possible dopamine supersensitivity psychosis, first had irritability, fear, paranoia and referential delusions during her university years. She improved on pimozide and biperiden, stopped treatment after four years, relapsed, and did not continue melperone.

At her first psychiatric hospitalization she showed severe fear-driven behaviors and delusional beliefs; physical and neurological examinations, routine laboratory tests, EEG and cranial CT showed no abnormalities, schizophrenia was diagnosed and haloperidol and biperiden were started, then switched for side effects to carbamazepine and diazepam. She was readmitted 10 days later with worsening symptoms and left at family request. Many antipsychotics later gave only partial benefit.

By 2023 she was on haloperidol decanoate, clozapine, aripiprazole, amitriptyline and biperiden and presented with blunted affect, dysphoria, persecutory delusions, passivity phenomena, auditory hallucinations, head-bobbing and tremors consistent with tardive dyskinesia. Aripiprazole was tapered with fewer hallucinations. During a surgery-clinic hospitalization for ileus and an ovarian abscess all psychiatric drugs were stopped; psychiatric treatment was gradually restarted, and she was seen again after that discharge.

Haloperidol decanoate was stopped for suspected contribution to DSP and not reintroduced; aripiprazole was raised to 15 mg/day for resurgent hallucinations and clozapine raised to 250 mg/day for intensified fear and paranoia, while dyskinesia and tremors resolved and biperiden was stopped.

Aripiprazole LAI was started with the two-injection regimen (two 400 mg injections plus a single 20 mg oral dose), then oral aripiprazole was stopped and she continued aripiprazole LAI 400 mg/month with clozapine 250 mg/day. Over the following weeks she improved, with reduced fear and paranoia, nearly resolved auditory hallucinations, greater social engagement and stabilization for the first time in many years.
